items.title: Retinal Optical Coherence Tomography-Angiography and Longitudinal Changes in Cognition and Cerebral Small Vessel Disease.
items.abstract: Cross-sectional studies suggest that retinal microvascular abnormalities measured by optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) are associated with cerebral small vessel disease (cSVD) and cognitive impairment, but longitudinal relationships remain unclear. We investigated whether OCTA measures are associated with brain cSVD markers and cognition over time and whether baseline OCTA was associated with brain and cognitive outcomes after mild ischemic stroke. We conducted a prospective longitudinal cohort study recruiting patients with lacunar or mild cortical ischemic stroke (modified Rankin Scale ≤2) from a hospital stroke service. Participants underwent OCTA, brain MRI, and medical and cognitive assessment (MoCA) at baseline and 1 year. OCTA metrics included vessel density (VD), foveal avascular zone area, vessel radius, tortuosity, and flow index from superficial and deep vascular layers. MRI outcomes included white matter hyperintensity (WMH) volume, basal ganglia perivascular space (PVS) volume, and mean diffusivity in normal-appearing white matter. We used linear mixed-effects models to assess (1) whether retinal measures were associated with brain and cognitive markers over time and (2) whether baseline retinal measures were associated with 1-year outcomes, adjusting for age, sex, systolic blood pressure, smoking, diabetes, stroke severity, disability, and stroke subtype. A total of 189 participants (mean age 64.8 years; 37% female) were assessed at baseline and 154 at 1 year. Longitudinal reductions in retinal VD were associated with WMH increase (superficial layer, standardized β [95% CI] -0.045 [-0.067 to -0.023]; deep layer -0.050 [-0.074 to -0.026]). Increases in retinal VD and reductions in retinal flow were associated with increased PVS volume. Lower MoCA over 1 year tracked with decreases in deep retinal VD (0.136 [0.036-0.236]). Baseline retinal measures were associated with future outcomes: In particular, lower baseline VD in both layers was associated with worse MoCA at 1 year (superficial layer 0.125 [0.043-0.207]; deep layer 0.242 [0.162-0.322]). OCTA-measured retinal microvascular features are associated with cSVD progression and worsening cognition after mild stroke, while baseline OCTA was associated with future brain and cognitive outcomes. These findings suggest that OCTA holds promise as a noninvasive tool for monitoring retinal microvascular pathology in stroke populations enriched for cSVD, warranting further investigation in larger cohorts.
items.summary_ja:
背景：網膜の微小血管異常は、光干渉断層血管撮影（OCTA）で測定され、脳の小血管病変（cSVD）や認知障害と関連するとされるが、縦断的な関係は不明であった。  
方法：軽度の虚血性脳卒中患者189名（平均年齢64.8歳）を対象に、ベースラインと1年後にOCTA、脳MRI、認知機能検査（MoCA）を実施。OCTAでは血管密度（VD）や血流指数などを測定し、MRIでは白質病変量や基底核周囲血管空隙（PVS）量を評価。線形混合効果モデルで、網膜血管指標と脳・認知マーカーの時間的変化および1年後の結果との関連を解析した。  
結果：網膜VDの減少は白質病変の増加と関連し、VDの増加および血流の減少はPVS増加と関連した。深層網膜VDの減少は認知機能低下（MoCA低下）と追跡された。ベースラインの低VDは1年後の認知機能悪化と有意に関連した。  
結論：OCTAで測定される網膜微小血管の特徴は、軽度脳卒中後のcSVD進行および認知機能悪化と関連し、非侵襲的なモニタリングツールとしての有用性が示唆される。さらなる大規模研究が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、軽度虚血性脳卒中患者を対象に、網膜の光干渉断層血管撮影（OCTA）による微小血管指標と脳の小血管病変（cSVD）および認知機能の経時的変化を調査した。網膜血管密度の低下は白質病変の増加や認知機能低下と関連し、基線のOCTA指標は1年後の脳病変および認知機能予測に有用であった。OCTAはcSVD患者の非侵襲的モニタリングに有望である。

items.title: How Language Shapes Mechanistic Thinking in Parkinson Disease.
items.abstract: Language often incorporates mechanistic assumptions. Terms used to describe protein behavior and properties, such as "accumulation," "replication," "propagation," and "strains," largely borrowed from prion biology and investigated in animal models, have shaped how Parkinson disease is understood. Similarly, clinical constructs such as "phenoconversion," "prodrome," "resilience," and "copathology" embed assumptions about disease onset and pathogenicity. In this article, we explore how our vocabulary has contributed to the transformation of hypotheses into widely accepted conventions. We argue that greater precision in language may help clarify the difference between observation and inference: Aggregated proteins can be described as pathologic deposits representing the insoluble fraction of proteins no longer in their soluble functional state, their variants as polymorphs rather than "strains," and seeding phenomena as nucleation-dependent aggregation or precipitation rather than replication. Such distinctions avoid conflating pathologic observations with etiology and have implications for biomarker interpretation, taxonomy, and therapeutic innovation.
items.summary_ja:
背景：パーキンソン病の理解には、プリオン生物学から借用された「蓄積」「複製」「伝播」「株」などの機械論的な言語が多用されている。また、「フェノコンバージョン」「前駆症状」「レジリエンス」「共病理」などの臨床用語も、病気の発症や病因に関する前提を含む。  
方法：本論文では、これらの言語表現がどのように仮説を広く受け入れられた通念へと変容させたかを検討し、観察と推論の区別を明確にするための言語の精緻化を提案した。  
結果：凝集したタンパク質は「病理学的沈着物」として、可溶性機能状態を失った不溶性タンパク質の一部と表現し、変異体は「株」ではなく「多形体」と呼び、種まき現象は「複製」ではなく「核形成依存的凝集・沈殿」と表現することが適切であることを示した。  
結論：言語の精密化により、病理学的観察と病因の混同を避けられ、バイオマーカー解釈や分類学、治療法開発に重要な示唆を与える。
items.summary_short_ja: 本論文は、パーキンソン病の理解において用いられる言語表現が機械論的思考を形成していることを指摘する。特に「蓄積」「複製」「伝播」「株」などの用語が病態解釈に影響を与え、観察と推論の混同を招いていると論じる。より正確な言語使用により、病理学的観察と病因の区別が明確になり、バイオマーカー解釈や分類、治療開発に重要な示唆をもたらすと結論づけている。

items.title: Trends in Emergent Interfacility Ischemic Stroke Transfers, 2016-2022.
items.abstract: Interfacility transfer for emergent treatment is critical to stroke systems of care. Understanding the transfer population enables transfer system optimization. We performed a nationwide longitudinal cross-sectional study to characterize the population emergently transferred for ischemic stroke care from 2016 to 2022. Using Medicare fee-for-service (FFS) claims, we included patients 65 years or older admitted with ischemic stroke. County-level Medicare Advantage penetration rates were used to extrapolate the results to estimate nationwide emergent transfers. Multilevel logistic regression identified features distinguishing the transferred from the nontransferred population. From 2016 to 2022, we identified 824,551 FFS beneficiaries (57% female) admitted for ischemic stroke: 99,751 (12%) underwent emergent transfer, while 724,800 (88%) were not transferred. The transfer population was younger (mean 78.2 years vs 80.1 years) with a higher rate of thrombectomy (15.9% vs 2.8%) and thrombolysis (24.1% vs 10.0%). Their presenting facility was more likely to be rural (55.3% vs 22.6%), have <100 beds (56.6% vs 11.9%), or be a critical access hospital (24.9% vs 2.8%). Nontransferred patients more frequently presented to a teaching facility (66.2% vs 32.3%), stroke center (83.2% vs 51.9%), or vertically integrated facility (93.5% vs 76.5%). Estimated nationwide emergent transfers increased from 2016 (21,221; 12% of admissions) to 2019 (26,720; 15%) and then decreased through 2022 (21,902; 12%). Multilevel logistic modeling showed a strong association between the transfer population and presentation to a critical access hospital (OR 2.8, 95% CI 2.4-3.3), prestroke hemiplegia (OR 2.3, 95% CI 2.3-2.4), or prestroke cerebrovascular disease (OR 2.2, 95% CI 2.2-2.3). Features associated with the nontransferred population include presentation to a facility with >400 beds (OR 0.01, 95% CI 0.01-0.01, reference ≤100 beds), a stroke center (OR 0.4, 95% CI 0.4-0.5), older age (OR 0.6, 95% CI 0.6-0.6), and more affluence (4th quartile of ADI OR 0.6, 95% CI 0.5-0.7). Emergent transfers for ischemic stroke in the United States have decreased since 2019, reversing a long-standing trend of continual increase. Receipt of thrombectomy or thrombolysis, presentation to a small facility, a nonstroke center, or in a less affluent area are associated with the transfer population.
items.summary_ja:
背景：脳梗塞の緊急治療における施設間転送は重要であり、転送患者の特徴把握はシステム最適化に不可欠である。  
方法：2016年から2022年の米国の65歳以上の脳梗塞患者を対象に、Medicareの請求データを用いた全国的な縦断的横断研究を実施。転送患者と非転送患者の特徴を多層ロジスティック回帰で分析し、全国推計も行った。  
結果：824,551例中12％が緊急転送され、転送患者は平均年齢が若く（78.2歳 vs 80.1歳）、血栓回収術や血栓溶解療法の割合が高かった。転送元は小規模病院やクリティカルアクセス病院、農村部が多く、非転送患者は大規模病院や脳卒中センター、教育病院に多かった。全国の緊急転送数は2016年から2019年に増加したが、その後2022年まで減少した。  
結論：米国の脳梗塞緊急転送は2019年以降減少傾向に転じている。転送は小規模施設や非脳卒中センター、社会経済的に恵まれない地域で多く、血栓回収術や血栓溶解療法の受療と関連している。
items.summary_short_ja: 2016年から2022年の米国における虚血性脳卒中の緊急施設間転送を調査した結果、転送患者は若年で血栓回収術や血栓溶解療法の割合が高く、小規模病院やクリティカルアクセス病院に多く、非転送患者は大規模病院や脳卒中センターに多かった。転送件数は2019年をピークに減少傾向にあり、転送は施設規模や地域の経済状況と強く関連していることが示された。

items.title: Prognostic Value of Blood-Based P-Tau217 Levels for Progression to Cognitive Impairment.
items.abstract: Blood-based biomarkers for Alzheimer disease, particularly plasma phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217), accurately reflect early Alzheimer disease brain pathology in cognitively unimpaired individuals, but estimates of absolute risk of progression to cognitive impairment across multiple cohorts are needed. To estimate absolute risk of progression to cognitive impairment and rates of cognitive decline based on plasma p-tau217 across cognitively unimpaired older adults. Longitudinal cohort study using harmonized data from 2684 cognitively unimpaired older adults (defined within cohort) across 6 observational and clinical trial cohorts based in North America, Japan, and Australia. The earliest enrollment was in 2004, with most recent follow-up in 2025. Baseline plasma p-tau217. The primary outcome was time to progression to cognitive impairment (mild cognitive impairment, dementia, or 2 consecutive global Clinical Dementia Rating scores ≥0.5). The secondary outcome was longitudinal change on the latent Preclinical Alzheimer Cognitive Composite (PACC; higher values indicate better performance). Among the 2684 participants (median [IQR] age, 69.6 [66.2-74.2] years; 1697 [63%] female), there were 478 events of progression to cognitive impairment over a median follow-up of 5.4 years (maximum follow-up of 13.5 years). Each 1-SD increase in baseline p-tau217 level was associated with an increased risk of progression to cognitive impairment (hazard ratio, 1.38 [95% CI, 1.30-1.46]), and the association remained significant after adjustment, including β-amyloid positron emission tomography scan Centiloids (hazard ratio, 1.32 [95% CI, 1.24-1.41]). Participants with high (1.1-2.4 SD) and very high (>2.5 SD) baseline p-tau217 had 24% (95% CI, 20%-28%) and 38% (95% CI, 33%-43%) absolute risk of progression over 5 years, respectively, and risk was markedly higher over 10 years, although longer-term estimates were constrained by limited data. Elevated p-tau217 was also associated with faster cognitive decline based on change in latent PACC score. Among the overall sample, baseline latent PACC scores ranged from -0.8 to 2.7. The 5-year annualized decline for the very high p-tau217 group was -0.07 latent PACC units/y (95% CI, -0.10 to -0.05), relative to 0.03 units/y (95% CI, 0.02-0.04) in the low p-tau217 group. In a pooled sample of multiple selected cohorts of cognitively unimpaired older adults, higher plasma p-tau217 levels were consistently associated with increased risk of clinical progression and accelerated cognitive decline. By providing time-specific absolute risk estimates, these findings support the potential of p-tau217 for prognostic model development, with direct implications for future trial design. Further validation in unselected populations is needed to inform individual prognosis and clinical decision-making in cognitively unimpaired individuals.
items.summary_ja:
背景：アルツハイマー病の早期脳病理を反映する血中バイオマーカー、特に血漿中のリン酸化タウ217（p-tau217）は、認知機能に障害のない高齢者における認知障害進行の絶対リスク推定が求められている。  
方法：北米、日本、オーストラリアの6つの観察・臨床試験コホートから2684名の認知機能正常高齢者を対象に、2004年から2025年までの縦断的データを用いて、ベースラインの血漿p-tau217レベルと認知障害への進行リスクおよび認知機能低下速度を解析した。  
結果：中央値5.4年の追跡期間中に478名が認知障害へ進行。p-tau217が1標準偏差上昇するごとに進行リスクは約1.38倍増加し、β-アミロイドPETを調整後も有意であった。高p-tau217群は5年で24～38％の絶対リスクを示し、認知機能低下も加速した。  
結論：血漿p-tau217は認知障害進行の強力な予測因子であり、将来的な予後モデルや臨床試験設計に有用である。ただし、一般集団への適用にはさらなる検証が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、認知機能に問題のない高齢者2684名を対象に、血中のリン酸化タウ217（p-tau217）濃度が認知障害への進行リスクおよび認知機能低下速度と関連することを示した。p-tau217値が高いほど5年以内の認知障害進行リスクが最大38％に達し、認知機能もより速く低下した。これによりp-tau217は予後予測や臨床試験設計に有用であるが、さらなる一般集団での検証が必要である。
